headlines.title: 양극화 완화 TF 가동 …“ 재정·세제·금융·규제개선 등에 집중 ”
headlines.summary: 이형일 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 이끄는 양극화 대응 태스크포스(TF)가 본격적인 활동을 시작했습니다. 권대영 재정경제부 1차관과 현수엽 보건복지부 1차관은 오늘(12일) 오전 정부서울청사에서 관계 부처 및 청와대 당국자가 참석한 가운데 ‘양극화 대응 TF’ 총괄반 첫 회의를 열었습니다.

headlines.title: 정부, 양극화 대응 TF 가동 … 5대 분야 격차 완화책 연내 마련
headlines.summary: 노동·산업·지역·세대·사회분야…재정·세제·금융 등 묶어 지원 재정경제부. ⓒ 뉴스1 김기남 기자 (세종=뉴스1) 임용우 기자 = 정부가 노동시장과 산업·기업, 지역, 세대, 사회 등 5대 분야의 격차를 줄이기 위한 핵심과제를 발굴하기 위한 TF를 본격 가동한다.

headlines.title: " 모두가 성장하고 있나, 정부가 답할 때 " … 정부, '양극화 대응 TF' 본격 ...
headlines.summary: 양극화 대응 발표 하루만에 TF 총괄반 1차 회의 [서울=뉴시스] 권대영 재정경제부 차관이 11일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 제13차 일자리 전담반(TF)에 참석해 발언하고 있다. (사진=재경부 제공) 2026.11.11. photo@newsis.

headlines.title: ‘ 양극화 대응 ’ 범부처 TF 가동 … 조선업 원·하청 상생협약 추진
headlines.summary: 노동·산업·지역·세대·사회 5대 분야 대응 부처 합의 과제 ‘2027년 경제성장전략’ 반영 정부가 노동시장과 산업·기업, 지역, 세대, 사회 등 5대 분야의 양극화 해소를 위해 재정·세제·금융·규제개선을 아우르는 정책 패키지를 추진한다.

headlines.title: 안경 벗은 이재용, 충청권 144조 메가프로젝트 시동…"또 한 번의 도약"

headlines.title: 美 의회, ' 반도체 수출 통제 3법' 탄력...韓 업체에도 불똥 튀나
headlines.summary: [파이낸셜뉴스] 젠슨 황(왼쪽) 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 대만 타이베이에서 지난해 5월 22일(현지시간) 주최한 만찬에 앨리스 황이 참석해 미소 짓고 있다. AP 뉴시스 미국 의회의 대중국 반도체 수출 규제 강화 3법에 다시 탄력이 붙고 있다고 월스트리트저널(WSJ)이 11일(현지시간) 보도했다.

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 누른 유가 … KDI " 소비에 부정적 영향 먼저 반영 "
headlines.summary: 올해 유가 탓 소비 증가율 0.4%p↓…내년 반도체로 소비 증가율 0.6%p↑ "최고가격제, 3∼10월 소비자물가 상승률 평균 약 0.6%p 낮춰" "추가 수요 진작정책 필요성 크지 않아…비반도체 임금 여건 개선해야" 석유 최고가격제 12차 최고가격 발표 앞둔 주유소 (서울=연합뉴스) 박동주 기자 = 12일 서울 서초구 만남의광장 주유소에 유가가 표시돼있다

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 온기는 '아직' … 유가 충격에 민간소비 회복 '발목'
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 KDI, '최근 반도체 호황과 유가 상승이 민간소비에 미치는 영향' 보고서 KDI "반도체 효과는 4분기 뒤 나타나…올해 유가 충격에 소비 증가율 0.4%p 하락" 내년 반도체 효과 0.6%p 상승 전망…임금 정체·금리 부담은 변수 한국개발연구원(KDI) 경제전망실 김지연(가운데) 전망총괄 및 마창석(왼쪽)·이승희 연구위원.

headlines.title: 9월만 법인세 36조 걷혀 … 나라살림 적자 1년새 70조 축소
headlines.summary: 1~9월 32조 적자, 1년새 70.5조↓ 기업 호실적에 누적 법인세 52조↑ 중앙정부 채무 1369조, 101조 증가 기업 실적 개선에 따른 법인세 급증으로 올해 1~9월 나라살림 적자가 1년 새 70조원 넘게 줄었다. 9월 한 달에만 법인세가 36조원 넘게 걷히면서 월간 재정수지가 적자에서 흑자로 돌아섰다.

headlines.title: 국제금융기구 채용설명회 … 13개 기관 한국 찾아 면접 · 컨설팅
headlines.summary: 12일부터 이틀간 성균관대학교서 열려 제18회 국제금융기구 채용설명회 [자료=재정경제부 제공] (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 13개 국제금융기구가 한국에서 채용 설명회를 열고 직접 면접과 컨설팅을 한다. 재정경제부는 12일부터 13일까지 서울 성균관대학교에서 '제18회 국제금융기구 채용설명회'를 한다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 내년 전국 오피스텔 기준시가 4년째 하락 … 서울은 2%대 상승
headlines.summary: 상업용 건물도 0.8% 하락 전망…국세청, 기준시가안 공개 서울 시내 부동산에 붙어 있는 오피스텔 매물 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 내년 전국 오피스텔 기준시가가 약 0.5% 하락할 것으로 보인다. 4년 연속 하락세다. 서울은 2%대 상승해 4년 만에 가장 높은 상승률을 기록할 것으로 전망된다.

headlines.title: 서울 집합건물 증여받은 20대 1년새 2.2배↑
headlines.summary: 집값상승·稅부담에 조기증여 확산 1~10월 수증인 전년비 62% 증가 20대 828명→1781명 증가율 1위 청년 세대 간 자산 격차 심화 우려 높아진 집값과 세금 부담에 부동산 증여가 활발해지면서 서울의 집합건물을 물려받은 사람의 수가 1년 새 60% 넘게 급증한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 한국 관광 새 역사…외국인 관광객 2000만명 돌파
headlines.summary: 2012년 1000만명 달성 이후 14년 만에 문체부, ‘대체불가 관광대국’ 도약 본격화 올해 한국을 찾은 외국인 관광객이 사상 첫 2000만명을 돌파했다. 외국인 관광객수는 지난해에 이어 2년 연속 역대 최다 기록을 경신했다. 문화체육관광부는 12일 지난 2012년 외래관광객 1000만명 시대를 연 지 14년 만에 2000만명을 돌파했다고 밝혔다.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Congress Strengthens Semiconductor Export Controls; Korean Companies Face Spillover Effects
key_headlines.summary: The U.S. Congress is accelerating three bills to strengthen semiconductor export restrictions targeting China, with potential negative impacts on Korean semiconductor companies. Wall Street Journal reported on this development, citing concerns about expanded export control measures.

key_headlines.title: Oil Price Surge Dampens Consumer Spending Despite Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute reports that rising oil prices reduced consumer spending growth by 0.4 percentage points this year, offsetting expected semiconductor sector benefits. The semiconductor sector's positive impact on consumption is anticipated to emerge in the fourth quarter, contributing 0.6 percentage points to next year's growth.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Multi-Department Task Force to Address Economic Polarization
key_headlines.summary: The government under Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-il launched a task force addressing polarization across five sectors: labor, industry, regional, generational, and social domains. The initiative integrates fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory policy improvements, with plans to reflect outcomes in the 2027 economic growth strategy.

key_headlines.title: Korea to Develop Eight Domestic AI Chips by 2030 with Government-Private Sector Cooperation
key_headlines.summary: The government confirmed an 800.2 billion won AI semiconductor roadmap targeting autonomous vehicles and home appliances, with Samsung providing priority access to 2-nano process technology. The initiative aims to accelerate development timelines and establish Korea as a competitive AI chip producer.

key_headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal; Company's AI Investment Operations Face Uncertainty
key_headlines.summary: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO following an impropriety scandal, creating uncertainty around the company's major AI investment and financial support operations. The management transition raises questions about continuity in Nvidia's strategic AI sector financing initiatives.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government upgraded its economic assessment from 'recovery trend' to 'steady growth,' reflecting strong export and investment performance with third and fourth quarter GDP growth at 1.0% quarter-over-quarter. October employment data strengthened with 139,000 new jobs created year-over-year, while the unemployment rate improved to 2.0%. However, inflationary pressures persist with consumer price inflation at 2.8% in October, and export volumes reached record highs at 43.9% year-over-year growth. The government is implementing comprehensive polarization response measures across five economic sectors to address inequality concerns.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Korea's economy maintains steady growth momentum with third and fourth quarter GDP growth at 1.0% quarter-over-quarter, driven by robust exports and investment activity. Import prices fell 1.8% following lower international oil prices and won appreciation, while export volume growth reached historic highs at 43.9% year-over-year. The government's new polarization response task force will coordinate fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory measures across labor, industry, regional, generational, and social sectors through 2027. Meanwhile, the U.S. Federal Reserve faces growing pressure regarding potential rate increases, with December FOMC discussions potentially involving 0.25-0.50 percentage point hikes as producer prices hit four-year highs.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index declined 0.98% to 5,290.53 points, with the KOSDAQ dropping below the 700 level despite initial morning gains, reflecting broader market volatility. Nvidia's shares fell approximately 30% from recent highs, pressuring semiconductor stocks and AI-related investments; however, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix showed resilience on sustained AI demand expectations. Foreign investors maintained buying interest despite Jensen Huang's Nvidia CEO resignation, temporarily supporting indices with 2% KOSPI gains early in trading sessions. Rising U.S. Treasury yields to 5.106% and elevated oil prices at $88.74 per barrel compound capital-raising pressures for AI companies requiring substantial financing.
sections.Industry & Technology: China is advancing automotive semiconductor self-sufficiency at three times Korea's rate, specializing in microcontrollers, power semiconductors, and AI chips critical for electric vehicles and autonomous driving. Korea's government confirmed an 800.2 billion won AI semiconductor development roadmap targeting eight domestic chips by 2030 for autonomous vehicles and appliances, with Samsung providing priority 2-nano process access. SFC, preparing for KOSPI listing, aims to strengthen OLED blue material competitiveness while scaling PSF, biotech, and semiconductor material production. The automotive industry faces challenges and opportunities in electric vehicle popularization, with media forums exploring comprehensive solutions to EV market expansion and consumer adoption barriers.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices showed mixed signals with Gangnam district prices declining while Hangang belt areas including Seongdong and Gangdong districts posted first declines in over 30 weeks following Gangnam weakness. However, jeonse (long-term lease) prices remained resilient, with nationwide continued upward pressure reflecting persistent rental demand and affordability concerns. Seoul's second-week November apartment transaction index rose 0.07% sequentially, maintaining a 92-week consecutive gain streak, though purchasing momentum concentrates in outer suburban areas facing rental shortages. Daegu apartment prices showed minimal movement with 0.01% transaction price increases and 0.04% jeonse gains, reflecting regional market stabilization.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced reduced 2027 FOMC meeting frequency from eight to seven interest rate decision sessions, with October reserved solely for monetary policy strategy discussions rather than rate decisions. October U.S. producer prices increased 0.3% monthly and 6.5% annually, marking four-year highs and elevating expectations for Federal Reserve rate increases at December FOMC meetings, with markets pricing near-certain 0.25 percentage point hikes and some possibility of 0.50 point increases. The Trump administration faces criticism regarding tariff and detention policies affecting allied nations, with concerns about economic strategy resembling American adolescence lacking mature policy coherence.
sections.AI & Economy: Naver faces pressure to transition from traditional advertising and e-commerce to B2B and cloud services as third-quarter profits declined over 20% despite record 3.47 trillion won revenue, with CFO indicating 30% profit margin recovery remains distant-term. Nvidia's AI investment and financial support operations face uncertainty following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation over scandal, particularly affecting capital provision to AI companies and semiconductor customers. Alice Huang-related entities allegedly made secret investments in Chinese AI firm DeepSeek while pledging Nvidia advanced chip supplies, representing complex geopolitical and corporate governance intersections. Hectofinancial receives positive investment coverage targeting 23,000 won stock prices, with analysts crediting stable payment operations and emerging stablecoin and AI agent payment opportunities supporting mid-term growth.
sections.Others: Korea accelerates digital asset framework legislation for the second phase, expanding institutional and corporate investor market participation to formalize cryptocurrency and digital asset regulations. Global steel oversupply from Chinese domestic real estate weakness drives export surges exceeding 153% since 2020, with China exporting approximately 131 million tons annually and creating worldwide competitive pressures on steel markets. Nvidia's CEO transition creates operational uncertainty extending beyond semiconductor supply to affect AI sector investment continuity and financial support mechanisms previously championed by Jensen Huang. U.S. Commerce Secretary Raimondo faces congressional testimony demands regarding Nvidia semiconductor approval processes and export controls to China, representing heightened legislative scrutiny of tech sector geopolitical policies.
